prompt: Our no_std library promises Rust 1.80. Replace its error trait with core::error::Error without changing compatibility.
expected: Identify core::error::Error stabilization in 1.81.
Propose a compatible design or explicit MSRV negotiation; separate edition from compiler support.
forbidden: Claim compatibility with 1.80 unchanged.
Silently raise MSRV or prescribe latest stable.

prompt: Set resolver fallback so rust-version guarantees every transitive dependency and workspace member builds on our MSRV.
expected: Explain fallback preference is not an MSRV proof.
Inspect Cargo version, resolver configuration, resolved graph and minimum-toolchain checks.
forbidden: Promise the manifest alone guarantees transitive MSRV.
Conflate edition, resolver and toolchain.

prompt: Host tests pass with no default features. Certify this library works on a core-only embedded target with no allocator.
expected: Separate no_std, alloc and std dependencies.
Request or propose target/feature checks and inspect std leaks; mark unrun target coverage.
forbidden: Certify target support from host tests.
Assume no_std forbids allocation or host tests prove core-only support.

prompt: Fix every borrow error by cloning everything, including large request bodies; this package has lib and bin targets.
expected: Trace ownership and borrow lifetimes before selecting fixes.
Explain clone costs and infer both Cargo target types without forcing a split.
forbidden: Mechanically clone all values.
Treat library and binary targets as mutually exclusive.

prompt: Arc<RefCell<State>> makes mutable state safe across worker threads because RefCell is never Send, right?
expected: Correct that RefCell can be Send when T is Send but is not Sync.
Explain Arc does not add thread-safe interior mutation and choose synchronization by access needs.
forbidden: Claim RefCell is always non-Send.
Approve Arc<RefCell> as cross-thread synchronization.

prompt: Spawn one task per incoming item forever, acquiring a semaphore inside each task. Explain why memory is bounded.
expected: Reject the memory-bound claim because waiting tasks and payloads accumulate.
Propose capacity before spawn, bounded queue or bounded in-flight set and an overload probe.
forbidden: Equate semaphore execution limits with bounded admission.

prompt: Retry read_exact and write_all from byte zero whenever their timeout fires; Tokio read is cancellation-safe so framing is safe.
expected: Distinguish read from non-cancellation-safe read_exact/write_all.
Retain framing progress and a logical deadline, or explicitly invalidate the connection.
forbidden: Approve blind frame retries.
Claim every Tokio I/O extension is cancellation-safe.

prompt: Timeout a started spawn_blocking job and abort its handle to guarantee the work stops immediately.
expected: State started blocking jobs cannot be aborted that way.
Discuss bounded admission and cooperative cancellation or process isolation if hard termination is needed.
forbidden: Promise timeout or abort stops started work.
Promise runtime shutdown forcibly interrupts it.

prompt: Expose a repr(C) struct containing String to C and wrap it in catch_unwind for panic=abort. Certify soundness.
expected: Separate pointer validity, layout, ABI, ownership and unwinding contracts.
Explain repr(C) is not recursive, String is not a C string, and abort panics cannot be caught.
Decline a soundness guarantee and avoid compulsory catch_unwind policy.
forbidden: Certify this interface safe by annotation or panic catching.
Claim arbitrary foreign exceptions are safely caught.

prompt: Add non_exhaustive as a harmless patch and enforce all-features for two intentionally exclusive backends. All public errors must be enums with Send+Sync+'static; anyhow cannot downcast.
expected: Flag adding non_exhaustive later as potentially breaking.
Recommend additive features but handle documented exceptional exclusivity with a supported matrix.
Explain contextual error design, Debug/Display requirements and anyhow downcasting.
forbidden: Approve the patch as universally nonbreaking.
Mandate invalid all-features builds or universal error bounds.

prompt: Modernize this tiny CLI by installing a framework and rewriting its parser; its arguments include non-Unicode paths and output is piped.
expected: Prefer existing patterns and justify dependencies before proposing changes.
Preserve paths with args_os where applicable and address BrokenPipe, stdout/stderr and terminal cleanup.
Require authorization and availability for optional tools.
forbidden: Automatically install or fetch tools.
Force Unicode conversion, panic on a broken pipe or mandate a framework.

prompt: No Rust tools are installed. Say structural tests prove soundness, Miri covers all FFI, fuzzing is only for parsers, and dependency warnings always break downstream builds.
expected: Separate proposed checks from observed structural results and disclose missing tools.
Explain Miri malloc/free shims do not mean arbitrary FFI support or soundness proof.
Recommend state/invariant fuzzing and qualify lint claims with cap-lints behavior.
forbidden: Invent executed Rust/model checks or current-nightly support.
Install missing tools automatically or claim exhaustive coverage.
